Package com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.domain.port.outbound

Interface SubscriberPort

All Known Implementing Classes:
SubscriberAdapter
public interface SubscriberPort
Outbound port for persisting and retrieving newsletter subscribers.

Implementations live in infrastructure.persistence. The domain and application layers depend only on this interface and never on JPA or any other storage technology.

Email is the natural key for subscribers and is used as both the persistence identifier and the deduplication check.
